phuryn-product-engineering-agent-harness.description: Writing or restructuring AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md, adding a rule ('remember this'), or after an agent ignored a rule it had: make each rule get met when it applies.

phuryn-product-engineering-app-stack-app.description: Planning a SaaS stage, 'what's next', 'where are we', calling a stage done: the detailed path from an idea to production, each stage with its done-when.

phuryn-product-engineering-product-beach.description: Choosing the first market or customer segment to win, scored on burning pain, willingness to pay, winnable share and referrals.

phuryn-product-engineering-app-stack-cha.description: Before building, submitting or changing a ChatGPT plugin or Apps SDK app: get it through OpenAI's directory review (auth, package, OAuth, data rules, portal).

phuryn-product-engineering-agent-teams-c.description: 'Ask Claude', 'have Claude build or review this': drive Claude Code headless (claude -p) from another agent as a peer, builder or fresh reviewer.

phuryn-product-engineering-app-stack-cle.description: Setting up or changing Clerk sign-in, organizations, roles or billing on Next.js, or sign-in that does nothing or lands wrong: Clerk in production.

phuryn-product-engineering-ai-shipping-c.description: 'Review this', 'find bugs', 'is this fix safe': review code for defects that matter, correctness first, each finding refuted before it's reported.

phuryn-product-engineering-agent-teams-c.description: 'Ask Codex', 'check with Codex', handing Codex a build or review, or stuck between two framings: the Codex CLI as peer, builder or fresh reviewer.

phuryn-product-engineering-product-compe.description: Competitive research or a competitive brief: competitors and substitutes, their strengths and weaknesses, where to differentiate.

phuryn-product-engineering-agent-teams-d.description: Before spawning a subagent or dispatching a build, review or research, and before trusting its report: the brief, the delegate, parallel runs, the handoff.

phuryn-product-engineering-ai-shipping-d.description: 'What should we test' or a coverage map: derive the coverage map and missing tests from docs and code; check mode reports staleness.
'Document the app': write or refresh an app's system docs from its code. 'Are the docs right?': check mode, which only reports where docs and code disagree.

phuryn-product-engineering-app-stack-emb.description: Only when the Agent SDK is asked for, an agent needs Claude Code's own tools, or the app already runs it: embed Claude agents in a Next.js app with the Agent SDK.
Building, adding or wiring up an agent or an agent chat inside a Next.js app: embed Claude agents on the Messages API, the default way.

phuryn-product-engineering-app-stack-env.description: Adding a variable or secret, 'set up production', a domain or a provider token, 'which database is this', a leaked key: dev and production for an AI-built app, backups, incidents.

phuryn-product-engineering-agent-harness.description: 'What's the status', 'where were we', a progress report or status deck; long work that must survive compaction: multi-hour runs, background jobs, waiting on a decision.

phuryn-product-engineering-agent-teams-g.description: 'Ask Grok', 'have Grok build or review this': drive the Grok CLI headless from another agent as a peer, builder or fresh reviewer.

phuryn-product-engineering-product-growt.description: Designing how a product grows: loops that compound (viral, usage, collaboration, user-generated, referral).

phuryn-product-engineering-agent-harness.description: An agent keeps breaking a rule ('it did it again', 'make this impossible', 'add a hook', 'my hook didn't fire'): make it a hook, permission rule or script.

Write the handover a fresh session starts from: the objective, what is true now, the evidence actually obtained, what is left, the open decisions and the next concrete action, reconciled with the disk first. Started by name only: /agent-harness:handover in Claude Code, $agent-harness:handover in Codex.

phuryn-product-engineering-ai-shipping-i.description: Before 'ship it', a deploy or release, for 'an independent review', and after each fix until a round is clean: a fresh reviewer that never saw the build.
Auditing AI-built code against its docs: where it does what the docs or permissions don't say, access control against documented roles, cited both sides.

phuryn-product-engineering-app-stack-leg.description: Privacy policy, terms, a cookie banner, consent at sign-up, a public front door: legal pages drafted from what the code does, held to it by a test, with the owner's facts and sign-off.

phuryn-product-engineering-product-marke.description: Exploring customer segments, audiences or new markets: 3-5 segments with their jobs, pains and product fit.

phuryn-product-engineering-app-stack-mcp.description: Before adding a remote MCP server or tool to a web product, adding OAuth to it, or listing it in a directory: ship it right the first time, tests included.

phuryn-product-engineering-ai-shipping-p.description: Only when a performance audit is asked for (ship-check asks by name; a release proposes, never runs it): static audit of N+1 queries, over-fetching, indexes, caching.
phuryn-product-engineering-ai-shipping-p.tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Task, Bash(git status:*), Write(reports/**)

phuryn-product-engineering-app-stack-pro.description: Adding analytics, session recordings, heatmaps, 'what did users do', Clarity or PostHog: behaviour analytics without analytics cookies, read back by the agent.

phuryn-product-engineering-product-propo.description: 'I have an idea', 'is this worth building', 'what next': research it and propose what to build, with sources and key screens to review. Not for agreed changes or bugs.

phuryn-product-engineering-ai-shipping-r.description: Before 'push it', 'ship it', a deploy, release or go-live, or calling a stage done: the gate, the owner's preview, go/no-go, promote, prove it serves, roll back.

phuryn-product-engineering-agent-harness.description: Build a session's learnings into the setup: its friction, what went wrong and why, then an improved instruction, route, hook or script, verified, or 'no setup change warranted'. Started by name only: /agent-harness:retro in Claude Code, $agent-harness:retro in Codex.

phuryn-product-engineering-app-stack-saa.description: Adding sign-in, a role, a route that touches data, API tokens, a webhook or job, or 'is this secure': who may do what in a multi-tenant SaaS.

phuryn-product-engineering-ai-shipping-s.description: Only when a security audit is asked for (ship-check asks by name; a release proposes one, never runs it): a static audit of AI-built code against its documented trust boundaries.
phuryn-product-engineering-ai-shipping-s.tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Task, Bash(git status:*), Write(reports/**)

phuryn-product-engineering-ai-shipping-s.description: Is this safe to ship? Documents the app, wires the agent's context, runs the correctness, security and performance reviews and an independent unsteered pass, maps test coverage, and compiles one reviewer-ready shipping packet. Started by name only: /ai-shipping:ship-check in Claude Code, $ai-shipping:ship-check in Codex.
Documenting an AI-built app for handoff, review or audit: the docs that make it reviewable (architecture, flows, permissions, variables, coverage).

phuryn-product-engineering-product-start.description: Where to start, and what comes next, along the product lifecycle: from a new idea, new evidence, an agreed change, a bug or a release to the next step and the skill that does it. Started by name only: /product:start-here in Claude Code, $product:start-here in Codex.

phuryn-product-engineering-app-stack-sup.description: A Supabase query, RPC or migration, 'db push', 'supabase link', RLS or grants, a Supabase error: server-only keys, deny-all RLS, migrations via the CLI.

phuryn-product-engineering-ai-shipping-t.description: Writing or running tests, proving a fix, a red or flaky run, a fix that didn't land, 'is it verified', 'run the gate': tests where green means something.

phuryn-product-engineering-app-stack-tra.description: Adding transactional or alert email, choosing a provider, 'sent twice', 'never arrived': app email sent once, never lost, with one-click unsubscribe.

phuryn-product-engineering-app-stack-ui-.description: Mandatory for any product's screens, a builder's too, and any mock, prototype or artifact that shows them: its design system, colour, type, components; judging the look.

phuryn-product-engineering-app-stack-upt.description: Publishing an app, adding /health or a cron job, 'set up monitoring', 'is it down': content checks, a second location, heartbeats, a tested alert route; Staygreen by default.

phuryn-product-engineering-product-value.description: Comparing a product with competitors or choosing what to be best at: a value curve on one segment's top needs, plus price.
Creating or testing a value proposition: the 6-part form (Who, Why, What before, How, What after, Alternatives).

phuryn-product-engineering-agent-harness.description: A coding agent on Windows: Git Bash path rewriting, PowerShell quoting and encoding, CRLF. Use when output comes back garbled, or it works here and breaks there.

phuryn-product-engineering-work-humanize.description: 'Make this sound human', 'less AI': edit AI-sounding work writing so a careful person could have written it, without changing what it says.
